integrity: The global bounds are analytic. Convexity reduces fixed-radius optimization to sign vertices; the unrestricted three-pattern case is bounded by an exact square factorization, and the modified case is a finite projective-sign count. The companion script checks the finite combinatorics and exact algebraic witness but is not used as a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Real three-dimensional supremum-norm space only. The claim concerns the upper third and upper modified third von Neumann–Jordan constants; it does not classify all equality cases, lower constants, complex scalars, or arbitrary dimensions.
title: Exact third von Neumann–Jordan gap in \(\ell_\infty^3\)
